lines.spoken: Every AI lab ships its own agent, in its own app.
Then one hits its usage limit, and your work just waits.
And it is all stuck on one machine.
SpecWithCode puts Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and more in one window.
Tell the coordinator what you want. It plans, briefs and routes. Threads do the work.
Each thread owns its job and keeps its context, so a follow-up goes to the thread that owns it.
Hit a usage limit, and the work continues on another provider, with its context.
Connect your Mac, Linux and Windows machines, with no port forwarding. The coordinator starts threads on the ones you allow.
And one Chrome extension serves every agent, in your real Chrome profile.
Claude Code alone runs Claude. T3 Code waits for the reset. SpecWithCode keeps your whole team working.
Free for Mac, Windows and Linux. At specwithcode dot com.
